featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

The 13-foot long statue, designed of stainless steel discs by Mumbai-based sculptor Valay Shende, was unveiled at Haji Ali on Friday. The installation is part of a private art foundation in partnership with Mumbai's municipal corporation.

featured_reviews.name: Adil Syed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location & Popularity
Bagdadi is located in a prime area of Colaba, making it easily accessible and always buzzing with people. The restaurant is extremely popular, especially during evening hours, which clearly reflects its strong reputation among food lovers.

Waiting Time
Due to the heavy rush during peak hours, particularly in the evenings, customers usually have to wait for their turn. While the wait can be a bit long, it also speaks volumes about how loved the food here is.

Food Quality
The food at Bagdadi is genuinely great. The flavors are rich, consistent, and worth coming back for. It’s one of those places where the taste truly lives up to the hype.

Ambience & Renovation (Personal Opinion)
In my personal opinion, the restaurant could really benefit from a renovation. The place feels a bit dated, and a refresh would greatly enhance the dining experience without taking away from its old-school charm.

Final Verdict
Bagdadi is a must-visit for its excellent food and prime Colaba location. Despite the waiting time and the need for renovation, the taste and authenticity make it well worth the experience—especially for those who don’t mind a little wait for good food.
